memory_update.text: PLPC is a rare listed pure-ish public play on transmission hardware plus robotic installation systems; it belongs in the underfollowed lane for grid labor/automation research.
MYRG is a smaller specialty contractor with direct T&D exposure and explicit utility line installation activity, making it a useful labor-constrained grid-build proxy.
For this node, the investable surface is split between hardware that reduces installation time and contractors whose throughput is constrained by craft labor availability.
The market appears to pay more attention to large contractors and diversified industrials than to transmission hardware vendors that can improve installation productivity.
